note.text: Documented by Dr. Webb during the virtual encounter based on symptom history and patient-submitted intraoral photos. Verification status is provisional: a virtual visit cannot confirm irreversible pulpitis or periapical involvement without a radiograph — that confirmation happens in-office at Interaction 3. Tooth designation uses the ADA Universal Numbering System (#9); FDI notation is deliberately NOT asserted, per ADA confirmation that FDI is not used for US dental data.
